title: Positive Psychology: Well-being, Happiness, Flourishing
summary: Positive psychology: Seligman's PERMA model (Positive emotion, Engagement, Relationships, Meaning, Accomplishment), character strengths, resilience, subjective well-being, and flourishing.
revision: Positive psychology: Seligman's PERMA model, character strengths, resilience, subjective well-being, flourishing.
traps: Positive psychology = scientific study of well-being and flourishing.
PERMA: Positive emotion, Engagement, Relationships, Meaning, Accomplishment.

notes.t: The scientific study of human flourishing, well-being, and the strengths and virtues that enable individuals and communities to thrive.

i: Positive emotion: happiness, pleasure, life satisfaction
Meaning: purpose, belonging to something larger
Character strengths: courage, wisdom, humanity, justice, temperance, transcendence
Resilience: capacity to adapt and recover from adversity
Subjective well-being: person's own evaluation of life satisfaction

notes.t: UGC NET may ask about Seligman's PERMA model and positive psychology concepts.

mnemonics.title: PERMA
mnemonics.text: P — Positive emotion, E — Engagement, R — Relationships, M — Meaning, A — Accomplishment

flashcards.a: Scientific study of human flourishing and well-being.
Positive emotion, Engagement, Relationships, Meaning, Accomplishment.
